integrity: Exact finite canonical identity plus a local-limit argument; numerical finite-size checks are corroboration only, not an independent proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed r>=2 and fixed q in (0,1); directed ring with constant per-occupied-site hop rates and finite canonical N.
Theorem describes stationary occupations in the order-sqrt(L) critical window and fixed order-1/sqrt(L) site-rate detunings; no mixing-time or general density theorem.
Absolute historical priority not established; a more general canonical ideal-Bose result might include the same limit.
title: Degeneracy-indexed chi laws and weak-splitting crossover at zero-range condensation onset
